name: Perspective 3D Menu
description: Full-screen page with a hamburger menu that tilts the whole content into a 3D perspective stack and reveals a vertical link list, switching between home, about, contact, services and portfolio panels.
contents: Top bar with two-part logo text and hamburger toggle
Five content panels: image hero with button, and four split text and image panels
Vertical link list on the right revealed when the menu opens
Two translucent layers behind the page that form the 3D stack
behavior: Hamburger tilts the page back with rotateY, translateZ and scale into a perspective stack
Clicking the tilted page or choosing a link closes the menu
Links fade in with staggered delays and the active link takes the accent color
Panels cross-fade with a slight scale when the link changes
